reviews.title: LOOKED LIKE A FUN GAME
reviews.text:
This looked like a fun game. I truly wanted to play it. Unfortunately, I never had any actual gameplay.  Hence the one star. To begin with the agreement window did not have a submit on either one. Yes, I read them. Had to  get completely out of the game. Reload it, just to accept the agreement. Secondly, the Home Screen never completely populated. Just a mostly brown background. It was not my browser or router causing the problem. I hope anyone who wants to play this game actually gets to. 
Developers…do better.

reviews.title: Fun but lots of spam bots
reviews.text:
This game is basically a simplified Ulala. Some of the gameplay is nearly identical. But, unlike Ulala, you don’t have to dedicate your entire life to playing this game.
My biggest complaint is all the spam bots. Lots of DMs and friend invites from AI bots. It gets annoying and there’s nothing you can do about it. Block one and more pop up.
This game is nothing like the ads. I don’t understand why games show something so entirely different in ads from what the real game is. Sometimes the developer will lie about it being future gameplay.

reviews.title: Another fake game
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game for around 2 months now and I just noticed an ad for the game that I haven’t seen before. It shows the game with a tower defense portion? I have no idea why someone would create an ad showcasing a portion of a game that doesn’t exist but there is no tower defense section or even remotely close to an activity like that. Games that do this should immediately be sued for false advertising. I know it’s not the first game to do it and the fact so many do this, shows how little respect any game company has for the players or people they try to bring in. I’ve played the game everyday but I will say until I stop seeing that fake advert, I will not change this review.

reviews.title: First 30 days great, onwards is cash grab
reviews.text:
I don’t know how anyone can recommend this game as f2p friendly at all. Every 30 days they add new features for the next “season” of content. In theory that sounds great, but it makes most previous content completely obsolete. After the 3rd season on a server you’ll be lucky to have 2 guilds of players remaining active and the server merging is far too slow. 

The competition across servers is very poor. Any server vs server competition is biased to those that started first (unless it’s a task based guild contest, in which case all new servers have the advantage due to the active players on those servers). This game needs to slow down the “new” content because it burns out the player pool to continue playing when it feels like everything they’ve done so far isn’t worth their time or money. At this point it feels like the devs truly do not care how the community feels and all feedback is ignored. 

This is purely a cash grab pump and dump. I’d be surprised if any player enjoys playing this past 6 months.

reviews.title: Basically Ulala
reviews.text:
As far as I can tell, the game is essentially Ulala but with more standard rpg classes (like in Go Go Muffin). The Fantamon are the equivalent of capturing the dinosaurs from Ulala.

It’s okay if you like that. I wish there was more of an emphasis on the Fantamon capturing though and more interesting things that could be done with them. It seems like they are just there as another form of equipment/stat boost/gatcha which feels kind of boring.

reviews.title: BOTS!!!
reviews.text: I want to start off by saying I play these type of games regularly and that I love the concept of this game and can see it being an amazing game, however, these bots are out of control. I’ve maybe played for 4 hours total and have gotten over 30 messages asking for personal info, or to join discord to “stay in touch” or a telegram/snap/whatapp/insta, it makes me not even want to log in. “Just block them” doesn’t work. They come in droves it’s such a huge problem in this game. Imagine if it was a kid they were messaging and didn’t know any better. These are scammers trying to steal personal info or get money out of you. Please fix this!!! You’ll never have a big customer base if you don’t and this game will die within the year.
